description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.
